name: Leaflet
source:
"I don't know what a mid-level magician thinks.. a genius magician like me has no familiars."

One of the Guardians in charge of the seal of Caderador. Guardian of the West. A genius magician whose abilities are second to none, despite his appearance. His words and deeds are arrogant.

Is there a reason why he's so mad at Raoul...? And what is his real face under those glasses?

[Translated from [url=https://www.pandora.nu/kuro/game/tukai/t_chara.htm]official website[/url]]
